prescription.notes: One core exercise, chosen and rotated by the engine from the core accessory pool that fits your equipment and limitations: anti-extension (hollow hold, L-sit, ab wheel), compression (hanging leg raise, knees to elbows, toes to bar, V-up), anti-rotation and lateral (Pallof press, side plank, suitcase carry, Copenhagen plank), front lever and more. Plank, dead bug and plank shoulder tap are left out here.
